title: Ordinary coefficient-presentation comparison for normalized rational realization
statement: Let ell be prime, E/Q_ell finite with lifted valuation ring A and uniformizer t [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let X be a noetherian finite-dimensional scheme with ell invertible and R any normalized RationalModuleRealization [lem-per-rational-module-realization-functor]. Write B for the completed coefficient sheaf [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum], a:A -> Gamma(B) for its canonical constant-section map, and S=B[1/a(t)] for sheafified section localization [def-weil-pbc-ringed-section-localization]. On Mod(S), use the canonical A[1/t]-action of [def-weil-pbc-scalar-localization-coefficient-actions], using its independent-universe interface [lem-per-rational-continuous-coefficient-derived-localization]; on Mod(E_X), use R.moduleLinear. For every functor F:Mod(B) -> Mod(S) whose object and map functions are the actual sheafified tensor extension along the canonical unit B -> S, there is an additive equivalence G:Mod(S) -> Mod(E_X) such that G.map(r smul f) = pbcRationalCoefficientEquiv(r) smul G.map(f) for every r in A[1/t] and every module morphism f, and a natural isomorphism F followed by G is isomorphic to pbcExtend(R.integralIso.hom followed by R.inclusion). Here pbcExtend is the ordinary sheafified tensor extension, not its derived functor. This statement contains no derived category, derived functor, localized-Hom comparison or Hom-continuity condition.

proof.text: Use the quotient-normalized integral comparison and inclusion of [lem-per-rational-module-realization-functor]. Projecting to each finite quotient identifies the constant sections. Localize the comparison sectionwise and sheafify. Its composite with R.localizationIso gives B[1/t] isomorphic to the continuous rational coefficient ring; on every integral numerator the unit agrees with R.integralIso.hom followed by R.inclusion. On fractions the same equality follows from invertibility of the uniformizer. Sheafification permits locally varying denominators.

proof.text: Let G be restriction of scalars along the inverse of the coefficient-ring isomorphism just obtained. The forward ring map gives its inverse, and both preserve underlying abelian sheaves, hence G is additive. Use the ordinary equivalence and tensor comparison of [lem-pur-ring-iso-derived-transport]. The source scalar r acts by its canonical section of S. The coefficient-ring comparison takes this section to the corresponding constant rational section: on A this follows from the preceding constant-section calculation, and extension to every fraction follows from [lem-weil-l-adic-integers-localization-uniformizer]. R.scalar_normalization identifies multiplication by this section with the recorded E-action, proving the semilinearity equation on every module morphism.

proof.text: The object and map equations pin F to the actual ordinary sheafified tensor extension. Its composite with inverse ring-isomorphism restriction is naturally ordinary extension along the normalized coefficient map. This is the ordinary tensor comparison of [lem-pur-ring-iso-derived-transport]: locally send s tensor m to the image of s tensor m; the inverse uses the inverse coefficient map. The coefficient-unit square proves the balancing relation, both composites fix pure tensors, and these maps sheafify and commute with module maps. This proves the required ordinary functor isomorphism; no derived or Hom-localization computation occurs.

theorem rationalRealizationOrdinaryLocalization (R : RationalModuleRealization l E X) :
    let B := pbcAdicCompletion X (pbcIntegralDatum l E)
    let a := pbcCompletedScalarSections X (pbcIntegralDatum l E)
    let t := pbcUniformizer l E
    let S := ringedLocalizationRingOfUniverses.{u + 1, u + 1, u} B (a t)
    letI := R.moduleLinear
    (fun [_localizedLinear : Linear (Localization.Away t)
        (pbcModules X S)] ↦
      ∀ (F : pbcModules X B ⥤ pbcModules X S)
        (hF : ∀ M, F.obj M =
          SheafOfModules.changeOfRingsOfUniverses
            (ringedLocalizationRingUnitOfUniverses.{u + 1, u + 1, u} B (a t)) M)
        (_hmap : ∀ {M N} (f : M ⟶ N), F.map f = eqToHom (hF M) ≫
          SheafOfModules.changeOfRingsHomOfUniverses
            (ringedLocalizationRingUnitOfUniverses.{u + 1, u + 1, u} B (a t)) M f ≫
            eqToHom (hF N).symm),
        ∃ (G : pbcModules X S ⥤ pbcModules X (rationalCoefficientSheaf l X E)),
          G.IsEquivalence ∧ G.Additive ∧
          (∀ {K L} (f : K ⟶ L) (r : Localization.Away t),
            G.map (r • f) = pbcRationalCoefficientEquiv l E r • G.map f) ∧
          Nonempty (F ⋙ G ≅ pbcExtend (R.integralIso.hom ≫ R.inclusion)))
      (_localizedLinear := rationalLocalizationModulesLinear X (PbcIntegralRing l E)
        B a t)
